header: The published schedule, as a description list
text: Day and time pairs in a real dl. One to ten rows, each with an optional qualifier on its own line under the hours.
note: Nothing here reads the clock: no day is marked as today and there is no 'open now' state, because a cached page would go on claiming to be open at midnight. Exceptions belong in this note.
